polishes.name: Yowie From the “cryptid Cremes”
polishes.stock_status: Formerly, Rapid Renewal Nail Elixir, now 7-in-1 Elixir, is a nail treatment designed to rejuvenate dry, brittle nails. Simply stated it is an oil and mineral infused base coat or stand alone treatment to be used and applied like a polish. The nourishing oils infused in this elixir deeply penetrate the nail bed, providing essential hydration and moisture. They help to restore dry and brittle nails. As the oils work their magic, your nails become stronger, more flexible, and less prone to breakage, allowing you to enjoy long-lasting manicures. With regular use, your nails will become visibly stronger, reducing the risk of splitting, peeling, and breakage. Wear alone or as a base coat underneath nail polish. To use, apply one thin coat, allow to fully dry. If using as a base coat under more polish, it is suggested to wash hands with soap and warm water to eliminate any oil residue on the exposed side of the base layer.
